title: For female patients with abnormally high total protein (TP > 8.5), find the
question: For female patients with abnormally high total protein (TP > 8.5), find the one whose anti-Cardiolipin IgA antibody level is the highest among those who also have a normal creatinine level (CRE < 1.5). Return her patient ID and the deviation of her TP from the upper normal limit (8.5).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", T2."XCL_020" - 8.5
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_020" > 8.5
  AND T2."XCL_056" < 1.5
ORDER BY T2."XCL_024" DESC
LIMIT 1

Return her patient ID and the deviation of her TP from the upper normal limit (8.5).

entity role: her TP from the upper normal limit (8.5)
